g.text: Design pattern 5 — Adapter (interchangeable GPS sources in the driver app)
JavaScript has no interfaces: GpsSource is the contract described in
the header comment of public/js/gps.js, satisfied by duck typing.
Problem solved: the system must be demonstrable without shuttles,
but the demo must exercise exactly the same upload path as a real
phone. The code that runs a trip uses only start/stop; the demo
control panel additionally calls SimulatedGps-only operations.
DeviceGps is the true adapter (it converts the browser Geolocation
API to the contract); SimulatedGps is an alternative implementation
of the same contract. The server processes both sources the same way;
each stored position keeps its "source" for the record and so that a
reloaded driver page resumes the source the trip was really using.
gps (null when no trip, or after a reload
until the driver chooses a source)
